exercises.instruction: Match the sentence beginnings on the left with the correct endings on the right.
items: 1 I said
2 She told
3 I told her
4 They said
5 We said
a me her name.
b happy birthday to him.
c goodbye to each other.
d the way to the station.
e that they were tired.

exercises.instruction: Fill the gaps with the correct form of say or tell.
items: 1 LARRY: Did she ............................ what time she was arriving?
RUBY: Yes, her train arrives at 6.30.
2 MICK: Have you ............................ Jim about the party?
FRAN: Yes, I’ve invited him.
3 YOLANDA: Did she ............................ thanks when you found her credit card?
PAULA: No, she just took it. You know what she’s like.
4 EILEEN: Did Bob ............................ any jokes at the dinner yesterday?
KIM: Yes, as usual he had some very funny ones.
5 TOURIST: Can you ............................ me when the concert starts, please?
LOCAL PERSON: Yes, 7.30.

exercises.instruction: What do you do in these situations? Use the verb ask in your answer.
items: Example: You are in a new city and want to know what to see, where to eat, etc.
Ask for information (e.g. at the tourist office).
1 You do not know how to get from place A to place B.
2 You are in the street and you don’t have your watch on.
3 You are in class and you do not understand a new word.
4 You have finished your meal in a restaurant.
5 Someone is playing a CD very loudly and you are trying to study.

exercises.instruction: Correct the mistakes in these sentences.
items: 1 The phone’s ringing! Will you reply to it, please, David?
2 My best friend lived in Denmark for five, years so she talks excellent Danish.
3 I sent him an email, but he hasn’t said back yet.
4 SVEN: How is said ‘Milan’ in Italian?
LENA: It’s ‘Milano’.
5 He said me an interesting story about when he was a child.
